variable.description: (Required) Unique identifier of the group to be cloned.

request.description:
Clone an existing group within the organization. This creates a new group with the specified name, copying the structure and settings from the source group.
 **Token scopes**: `groups:write`

Edit the details of an existing group.
 **Token scopes**: `groups:read`, `groups:write`

Create a new group within your organization.
 **Token scopes**: `groups:read`, `groups:write`

query.description: The maximum number of groups to return (between 1 and 100)
Sort the results in ascending (ASC) or descending (DESC) order based on the group name.
The encoded cursor for paginated results. This is an opaque string that allows fetching the next set of results.
Include archived groups (soft deleted records). Defaults to `true`.
Extra information about the group.
